scope: Eight exact complete-provider findings remain conditional unsupported. LiveCaptions is reopened because fixed official SIG source contains real local ASR and public inference payloads. Model license and actual system/QEMU behavior remain pending; reopening is not a fix or pass.

ScreenReader.reason: Accessibility framework exists; no verified matching screen reader/TTS complete provider in inspected sources or official prebuilt index.

DesktopLyrics.reason: AVSession connector exists; no verified matching DesktopLyricAbility provider. Music_Demo installs a different bundle and is not this backend.

ExpandedTextMenu.reason: ACE exposes plugin loader/ABI; no matching complete action/backend implementation or artifact in inspected official sources.

TextServicePlugins.reason: Share/translation/analyzer loaders/interfaces/default fallbacks exist; no verified matching complete content/model/service plugins for QEMU.
